incidents.root_cause: The native suite lacked disposable black-box Git workspaces, so detached-head and cpa final-state failures were found only through manual dogfood.

regression_cases.test_name: detached_head_recoverable_converges
detached_head_unrecoverable_fails_explicitly

incidents.root_cause: Nested-repository resolution accepted an untracked ancestor because git rev-parse walked up to the parent worktree, which could attribute child work to the wrong repo and skip the child commit wave.

regression_cases.test_name: plan_file_commit_push_converges_registered_submodule_child_before_parent
multi_repo_commit_push_pushes_root_and_unregistered_nested_repo

incidents.root_cause: The clean-workspace commit-push path could report success before publishing commits that were already ahead of the push remote.

regression_cases.test_name: clean_not_ahead_is_noop_success
clean_but_ahead_continues_to_push
plan_file_clean_but_ahead_continues_to_push
clean_unpublished_commit_without_push_remote_fails_explicitly

incidents.root_cause: Agent-mode cpa could fall back to the human AI planning route or depend on manual repair of missing or stale shared plan metadata.

regression_cases.test_name: agent mode CPA fails closed on a missing shared plan without mutation
agent mode CPA rejects a stale shared plan without rewriting it
agent_mode_cpa_with_message_does_not_inject_shared_plan

incidents.root_cause: Plan-backed exact staging ran git reset before applying includes, converting unrelated pre-existing index entries into unstaged working-tree state.

regression_cases.test_name: commit_push_plan_file_preserves_unrelated_staged_paths

incidents.root_cause: Plan-file post-sync gitlink classification inspected every dirty parent gitlink instead of applying the plan include/exclude scope.

regression_cases.test_name: commit_push_plan_file_ignores_out_of_scope_post_sync_gitlinks
commit_push_plan_file_auto_amends_in_scope_post_sync_gitlinks

incidents.root_cause: Synthetic message-plan generation emitted multiple entries for a registered nested repository while leaving some include/exclude scopes unset, so strict plan validation rejected an otherwise unambiguous commit.

regression_cases.test_name: message shorthand commit coalesces registered child and parent gitlink work
message shorthand commit-push converges registered child before parent

incidents.root_cause: Native push captured network Git output instead of passing the human terminal through, while persisted credential.interactive=never configuration was only displayed by auth doctor and not treated as a repairable blocker.

regression_cases.test_name: auth doctor diagnoses and fixes credential interaction disabled across local and global config
human interactive push streams git output and serializes credential-capable workers

incidents.root_cause: Recursive sync rendered its plan and per-repository detail only after the dependency scheduler returned, while registered submodule candidates were not required to equal their Git top-level; uninitialized paths therefore stayed silent during long work and could execute twice against their ancestor repository.

regression_cases.test_name: recursive sync reports live progress before and during network work
recursive sync skips uninitialized registered submodules without ancestor fallback

incidents.root_cause: The TUI assumed a dark terminal through bright hard-coded RGB colors, started an unconditional full-workspace refresh, loaded complete Git history synchronously, cleared history caches without reconciling active detail state, parsed dirty path identity as trimmed display lines while process capture discarded bytes after the first NUL, prefetched an unbounded number of file patches, and did not guard terminal restoration for the complete screen lifetime.

regression_cases.test_name: TUI auto theme uses COLORFGBG when available and stays adaptive when unknown
TUI keymap omits retired fetch commit and push shortcut claims
TUI refresh reconciliation keeps history on the same repository and closes stale detail
TUI history fetch plan stays page bounded with one look-ahead row
TUI history parses NUL name-status paths including rename and newline bytes
TUI working-tree status preserves exact NUL-delimited path identities
TUI patch detail budget caps Git fetch launches and bytes
ShellExecutor capture preserves embedded NUL bytes
TUI terminal guard restores captured state after the screen lifetime

incidents.root_cause: The FTXUI dashboard performed trusted-manifest repository I/O before entering the interactive loop; an initial async rewrite could post completion before ScreenInteractive installed its task sender, then kept serial per-repository Git probes under one five-second aggregate deadline. The versioned overview serializer also left some JSON control bytes raw, rejected configured external repositories, and a missing first-run manifest produced no selectable root repository. The first fallback draft further represented unsampled audit booleans as clean. These ordering and contract gaps could delay, reject, remove, or misrepresent the first usable audit state.

regression_cases.test_name: TUI first frame schedules startup I/O after ScreenInteractive activation and handles q while pending
TUI load lifecycle exposes every audit state
TUI startup snapshot parser preserves bounded repository audit fields
TUI production startup loads a disposable three-repository inventory through the built KOG binary
TUI production startup exposes a bounded root fallback before first discovery
TUI production startup rejects an invalid existing workspace manifest
TUI production startup admits only configured external repository roots
TUI startup snapshot parser rejects unconfigured external repository paths
TUI production overview JSON escapes POSIX control bytes in repository paths

incidents.root_cause: Plan-backed commit-push wrote meta.executed_at_utc and printed an executed summary without checking the terminal push result, while post-apply verification accepted any non-empty stamp as successful completion.

regression_cases.test_name: plan_file_push_failure_leaves_execution_unstamped_and_retry_stamps_after_convergence
plan_file_profile_path_push_failure_leaves_execution_unstamped_and_retry_stamps_after_convergence
plan_file_post_apply_rejects_non_utc_execution_stamp

incidents.root_cause: The audit runtime script was introduced with Git index mode 100644 even though shell hygiene requires 100755, and host filesystem permissions cannot reliably prove the tracked mode across platforms.

regression_cases.test_name: audit runtime script is tracked executable in the Git index

incidents.root_cause: The durable audit callback refactor in 5924f21 removed CaptureLimits from the ExecuteCommand implementation and both platform runners while leaving the public signature, bounded TUI callers, and regression tests unchanged. The initial repair bounded only a wrapper callback while the legacy native process API still retained complete streams internally. This made synced main fail to link and, after linking was restored, still left large audit output able to grow native capture memory without a bound.

regression_cases.test_name: Kano process V2 bounds native retention while delivering complete audit callbacks
ShellExecutor bounded capture preserves complete audit progress callbacks

incidents.root_cause: The regression report test searched the entire human-readable report for ordinary words such as executed, so valid historical root-cause prose caused a false execution-evidence failure. Separately, 5924f21 changed two agent CPA tests from automatic shared-plan repair to explicit fail-closed preparation without updating their exact source-linked manifest names.

regression_cases.test_name: dogfood incident manifest maps stable source cases without execution claims
default registry paths and exact test names resolve to source

incidents.root_cause: The bounded history dashboard advertised repository-wide time-ascending and match-first sorting, but its implementation only reversed or stably partitioned the currently loaded page slice. The canonical history key guide also omitted the active search, next-match, and order controls, leaving the misleading behavior difficult to audit or discover.

regression_cases.test_name: TUI history page ordering stays explicitly scoped across bounded pages
TUI keymap exposes page-scoped history search and ordering controls

incidents.root_cause: The macOS kano_git_tui_tests target let Catch2 decompose direct std::string_view assertions, but the linked Catch2 binary did not provide the matching StringMaker specialization. This left the complete TUI test target with an undefined StringMaker<std::string_view> symbol at link time despite the history-order assertions being semantically valid.

regression_cases.test_name: TUI history page ordering stays explicitly scoped across bounded pages

incidents.root_cause: Operation-audit reservation and publication used ordinary Win32 filesystem and CreateFileW paths. An absorbed submodule common Git directory produced a 265-character publication path, so agent-mode converge failed before Git mutation with Win32 error 3.

regression_cases.test_name: KG-BUG-0101 operation audit reserves long paths in an absorbed submodule common git directory

incidents.root_cause: The default converge rebase strategy delegated target synchronization and source integration to git merge --ff-only, so an operation requested as merge-free still invoked Git's merge porcelain.

regression_cases.test_name: converge branches apply fast-forwards target without git merge and pushes
converge branches retire keeps a target already ahead of upstream
